goal.title: Build a sustainable halal business and asset base toward an aspirational $1,000,000+ net worth within approximately 5–7 years.
goal.description: Build sustainable halal businesses, develop valuable skills, generate and retain legitimate profits, reinvest intelligently, and accumulate productive assets over approximately 5–7 years, with an aspirational long-term target of $1,000,000+ net worth.

years.title: Foundation, Launch, Validation and Operating Systems
years.objective: Operate both businesses in parallel, gather real market evidence, establish repeatable systems, and develop disciplined execution.

phases.title: Foundation, Launch, Validation and Operating Systems
phases.objective: Launch both business tracks and establish the operating systems that will carry execution forward.

months.title: September 2026
months.objective: Launch the first E-Commerce advertising campaign and begin the YouTube Automation business.

weeks.objective: Launch the first E-Commerce advertising campaign, begin the YouTube Automation business immediately, establish baseline measurement, and collect the first real-world evidence from both business tracks.

tasks.title: Complete final E-Commerce pre-launch QA
tasks.description: Complete final store QA before the first advertising campaign, including the product page, offer, customer journey, payment/COD process where applicable, shipping/fulfillment information, and analytics/tracking.

tasks.title: Finalize E-Commerce advertising creatives
tasks.description: Finalize the advertising creatives required for the first controlled campaign.

tasks.title: Finalize E-Commerce campaign settings
tasks.description: Complete the campaign configuration and confirm the campaign is ready for launch on 29 September 2026.

tasks.title: Establish E-Commerce test budget limit
tasks.description: Define the maximum amount the project owner is willing to risk on the initial controlled advertising test.

tasks.title: Record E-Commerce launch assumptions
tasks.description: Record the assumptions, expectations and baseline information for the first advertising test in USMANI OS.

tasks.title: Launch first E-Commerce advertising campaign
tasks.description: Launch the first E-Commerce advertising campaign on 29 September 2026 and confirm that the campaign is delivering correctly.

tasks.title: Monitor initial E-Commerce campaign delivery
tasks.description: Monitor campaign delivery and identify technical or operational problems after launch.

tasks.title: Track initial E-Commerce campaign data
tasks.description: Record relevant advertising spend, traffic/click data, conversion information, orders and customer inquiries as data becomes available.

tasks.title: Monitor E-Commerce customer and fulfillment issues
tasks.description: Monitor customer questions, order issues, fulfillment problems, refunds/RTO issues where applicable, and other operational observations.

tasks.title: Document E-Commerce initial observations
tasks.description: Record meaningful observations from the first advertising campaign and identify possible problems with the advertisement, offer, store or customer journey.

tasks.title: Make only justified E-Commerce adjustments
tasks.description: Make changes only when supported by available evidence. Avoid emotional decisions based on very limited early data.

tasks.title: Complete Week 1 E-Commerce review
tasks.description: Review the first campaign data and document what happened, what was learned, and what should be investigated or tested next.

tasks.title: Finalize initial YouTube channel direction
tasks.description: Finalize the initial channel direction for the YouTube Automation business.

tasks.title: Define YouTube target audience
tasks.description: Define the intended target audience for the initial YouTube channel.

tasks.title: Define YouTube content angle
tasks.description: Define the initial content angle for the YouTube channel.

tasks.title: Set up YouTube channel
tasks.description: Create and configure the initial YouTube channel.

tasks.title: Research initial YouTube content opportunities
tasks.description: Research potential initial video topics and content opportunities.

tasks.title: Select initial YouTube topics
tasks.description: Select the first batch of video topics based on the project owner's research and decisions.

tasks.title: Establish YouTube production workflow
tasks.description: Establish the initial workflow for research, scripting, voice production, editing, thumbnails and publishing.

tasks.title: Create first YouTube script
tasks.description: Research and create the first video script.

tasks.title: Produce first YouTube video
tasks.description: Produce the first YouTube video using the established workflow.

tasks.title: Create first YouTube thumbnail and title package
tasks.description: Prepare the thumbnail and title package for the first video.

tasks.title: Publish first YouTube video
tasks.description: Publish the first YouTube video if production is completed during the week.

tasks.title: Begin next YouTube video
tasks.description: Begin production of the next video so the workflow continues beyond the first upload.

tasks.title: Document YouTube production lessons
tasks.description: Record what worked, what slowed production down, and what should be improved in the next production cycle.

tasks.title: Record Week 1 objectives in USMANI OS
Record E-Commerce execution in USMANI OS
Record YouTube execution in USMANI OS
Complete Week 1 daily reports
tasks.description: Use the existing daily report system to record actual execution, blockers, lessons and outcomes.

tasks.title: Complete Week 1 weekly review
tasks.description: Review the week across E-Commerce, YouTube Automation and personal execution, then identify what should influence Week 2 planning.

milestones.title: E-Commerce First Advertising Launch
milestones.description: First E-Commerce advertising campaign launched and operating as a controlled real-world test.

milestones.title: YouTube Automation Started
milestones.description: Initial YouTube channel and production workflow operational, with first content produced/published or at final publishing stage.

milestones.title: Week 1 Evidence Review Complete
milestones.description: Week 1 results, observations and lessons recorded and reviewed for planning the next week.
